authorization.current: Read existing local recipes and working C-v3 interfaces; write this plan and scope notes only.
not_authorized: Remote access, staging, lock acquisition, metadata probes or tool execution
Local or remote support compilation or control execution
Objects, assembler, linker or generated compiler/image execution
Nonzero placement, target/semantic preflights, timing, queue relaunch
State, source branch, evidence publication or GitHub changes
future_dispositions: Root reviews and pins the final frozen C-v3 source/control/receipt package and this completed plan.
Root separately authorizes new-root staging, identity checks and exactly one support build.
Root reviews actual support receipts before separately authorizing BASE objects.
CANDIDATE objects requires its own root authorization after every strict BASE gate and independent receipt review passes.

historical_inputs_preserved.failed_v2_gate: inside-zero whole-image SHA mismatch; no candidate launch
historical_inputs_preserved.rule: Never overwrite, resume as v3, delete, relabel or reuse the failed v2 output. Do not rebuild the qualified normals or rerun any completed historical command.

proposed_new_root.rule: After separate authorization, require exact ENOENT for the new root and each producer output before creation. Existing path or ambiguous stat failure stops; do not choose another path or relaunch automatically.

author_expected_freeze_paths_not_created: Separate final c-review-v3 receipts and manifest, exact paths pending owner freeze
pending_freeze.rule: Fill only from the completed author freeze and exact independent review. No hash, count, control total, source approval or expected success is inferred from mutable working files or old C-v2. The pre-freeze parser edge must be resolved and reviewed before any operation.

production_source_delta_from_frozen_v2: hp_method.c includes hp_normalize.h and invokes guarded normalization after direct-normal SHA passes and before inside-zero.
New hp_normalize.c and hp_normalize.h add a ninth support implementation unit and pair-bound normalization proof/serialization APIs.
method_controls.c changes; normalize_controls.c and normalize_probe.c are development/control inputs, not support build translation units.
working_interface_observations_not_quali.objects_cli: Observed unchanged: objects --tree --out --normal --manifest --flags-reference --sources-reference --tc --normal-sha256; exactly eight name/value options, no normalization bypass switch.
new_artifact_contract: checker.raw.s preserves raw generated assembly; checker.s is a separately written canonical derivative.
normalization.json records pair/profile, input/output/direct-object hashes and guarded edit geometry; input buffers/files remain unchanged.
Snapshot must include nonempty regular checker.raw.s, checker.s and normalization.json.
Observed ready.nul schema is buster-hot-placement-c-v3; do not accept v1/v2 prepared roots or readiness markers as v3.
working_interface_observations_not_quali.normalization_contract_to_confirm_at_fre: Only exact source-manifest/qualified-normal tuples are supported. Each role independently must satisfy assembly and direct-object guards. No on-disk binary patch, general x87 rewrite, weakened object proof or waived strict whole-image SHA is allowed. Candidate has not been qualified by BASE behavior.
working_interface_observations_not_quali.pending_parser_edge: Author reports a working fix for global label census with whitespace/trailing/chained definitions and conservative refusal of quoted/escaped labels. Matching fresh controls and final source/receipt review remain pending prerequisites; this plan pins no working hash and certifies none of them.

external_pins.rule: Verify current source/tool/resource/license/Wild/host-guidance pins and full existing toolchain inventory before and after authorized operations. A changed pin stops for review; no install, permission change or cache substitution. Prior versions/counts are historical references, not a fresh verification.

normal_references.rule: Rehash full source bytes/modes, normal images and original NUL refs before and after each role. Never regenerate references, relink a normal or substitute old 6a/b68/sanitized/other-host binaries. Reusing an unchanged reference is not rerunning its construction.

clean_environment_and_lock.invocation_order: Literal argv: /usr/bin/env -i -C PHASE_CWD, only the explicit common env plus phase PATH/title, then the genuine exclusive prefix and literal phase command. No shell eval or new orchestration helper.
caller_must_not_supply: Compiler/include/library/preload/config or shell-startup overrides outside the reviewed explicit selection
clean_environment_and_lock.path_reason: The support build starts with TC/bin. The objects caller starts with base PATH only because reviewed hp_prepare_environment prepends TC/bin itself, preserving the qualified normal effective PATH without duplication.
clean_environment_and_lock.fairness: One genuine per-run lock per operation; no outer-series reservation or inherited HELD. Waiting with CI is outside the inner cap. Recheck real cores availability only if authorized; prior absence is not a fabricated grant or permission to change scheduling.

preconditions: All pending_freeze identities and exact final review filled and cleared by root
Fresh host guidance/availability/disk/root-absence observations authorized and retained
Stage only the frozen reviewed C-v3 source archive and manifest into NEW Q3; verify archive, all regular files, modes, path list and empty nonregular inventory
Verify normal/source/NUL refs and official toolchain pins/inventory without changing old roots
Output bin/hp_method absent; no prior support binary accepted
planned_support_phase.exclusive_title: Buster #883 frozen C-v3 support-tool build only
planned_support_phase.support_linker_note: This is the exact prior support recipe plus hp_normalize.c; it has no explicit linker override. BUSTER_LINKER is recorded for future C-method use. Do not infer that the support binary itself linked with Wild solely from that environment variable.
planned_support_phase.required_result: Exactly one actual build exit 0, immutable source/tool/ref pre/post checks 0, new binary SHA recorded and independently reviewed. No hp_method execution, including help, occurs in the support phase.
planned_support_phase.on_failure: Preserve exact nonzero/timeout/partial receipts and perform separately authorized read-only postchecks. Stop all dependent work; no build retry or replacement pass.

base.requires: Separate root authorization after frozen-input and actual support-build receipt review
base.exclusive_title: Buster #883 C-v3 BASE objects and strict zero control

candidate.requires: Fresh separate root authorization only after every BASE strict gate, external postcheck and independent actual-receipt review passes; never launch in parallel or from a merely zero child status
candidate.exclusive_title: Buster #883 C-v3 CANDIDATE objects and strict zero control

strict_per_role_requirements: Fresh output absent; exact frozen v3 source/support binary, full 805/807 source/modes, normal and original NUL reference pins checked before launch
Main actual exit 0 after same-session waits; every recorded child status 0; no missing or inferred outcome
Actual default/effective C and assembler driver target/CPU/ordered feature vectors agree; explicit empty feature vector is not relabeled as an expanded implicit vector
Direct-normal full SHA equals the exact qualified role normal before normalization
Role-bound normalization guards and exclusive normalization.json succeed; checker.raw.s and original object remain exact; canonical checker.s is separately hashed
Reassembled object proof and linked proof pass with no waiver; inside-0/compiler full SHA equals the qualified normal
Both internal final source checks, complete snapshot (including raw/canonical/normalization receipt), prepared.json and v3 ready.nul exist and verify
Separate external full source/mode/support/tool/ref checks run after the command even if it fails; they do not substitute for unreached internal gates
Independent actual-artifact/receipt review confirms all statuses, full hashes, pair/source binding, raw/canonical distinction and proof/snapshot boundaries before any dependent operation
planned_objects_phases.on_any_failure: Preserve first failed/partial root and exact receipts, stop candidate and all dependent operations, collect only separately authorized read-only evidence. No queue relaunch, retries, new budget, source/gate weakening or replacement success.

record: Actual literal argv, selected NUL environment, cwd, owner/title/link, lock wait messages, timeout setting
Launch result, every same-session poll/resume and actual terminal status; observations are not exact CPU/command timers
Split stdout/stderr, all child argv/status files, raw -MJ metadata and driver jobs
Normalization receipt, raw/canonical/object hashes, object/linked proofs, snapshot and readiness only if actually reached
receipt_policy.async_rule: If a tool call yields a live session, resume that original session to completion. Pending is not failure, success or permission to launch another invocation. Never relaunch a queued command.
receipt_policy.publication_rule: Retain failures and old roots byte-exact. Future evidence must distinguish support build, strict object compatibility and later execution/timing. Nothing in this plan changes compiler source, draft/certification gates or landing authority.
